explication: Nexus Delta is the ecosystem’s data- and knowledge-graph lifecycle service. Users manage projects and resources through its API; Delta represents data as RDF/JSON-LD and offers storage and indexing capabilities, including views. The tree shows routes, plugins, and RDF support, but most runtime wiring was not sampled, so the graph keeps those relationships conservative. The README supports the API and indexing capability; source-index references support the sampled resource and storage relationships.
